items.title: Seed the sandbox's test records with a script
items.body:
## Summary

An alternative to the hand-seeded #3–#5: the sandbox's test records come from a script, so they can be rebuilt and reviewed as code.

```diff
 workspace-fixtures/
+└── seed/
+    ├── seed.sh      # gh only; labels each record; a second run skips seeded cases
+    └── README.md    # the four cases and how to re-seed one
```

```text
seed.sh [owner/repo]
  labels: fixture, case/open-issue, case/not-planned, case/merged-pr, case/draft-pr
  for each case
    if a record carries its label → skip
    else create it through the API (no local checkout)
```

| Case | Record |
| --- | --- |
| `case/open-issue` | #6, open, assigned, task list and table, 3 comments (one with a code block) |
| `case/not-planned` | #7, closed as not planned |
| `case/merged-pr` | #8, merged; 4 files (3 added, 1 modified); a `COMMENTED` review with an inline comment; a conversation comment; on its head the push and pull_request runs plus two commit statuses (`fixtures/schema` success, `fixtures/links` failure → combined `failure`) |
| `case/draft-pr` | #9, open draft |

The answers are captured in laserjm/workspace-prototype (alternative to laserjm/workspace-prototype#69). Records #6–#9 already exist: I ran the script from this branch.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the cases exist only as hand-made records (#1–#4) and prose in README.
  **After:** `seed/seed.sh` created #6–#9; a second run printed `already seeded` for all four. API checks: #6 open with 3 comments; #7 `state_reason: not_planned`; #8 `merged: true`, `changed_files: 4`, `review_comments: 1`, combined status `failure` with 2 contexts, runs `push success` and `pull_request success` on head `7b55399`; #9 `draft: true`.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Merging adds two files. The records #6–#9 already exist either way. If the other approach wins, close this PR and delete #6/#7 (#8 and #9 can only be closed).

**Blast Radius:** sandbox

The broad search answers of the other capture (`repo:laserjm/workspace-fixtures`) now also list #6–#9 when re-captured.

items.title: Document the seeded GitHub fixture cases
items.body:
Document the seeded records used by `laserjm/workspace-prototype` issue 55 and how to preserve them for repeatable GitHub API captures.

- Issue #1 stays open with three comments; issue #2 is closed as not planned.
- Seed PR #3 is merged with four changed files, a discussion comment, a submitted comment review and an inline review comment.
- PR #4 stays open in draft.
- PR #3’s head has successful Actions runs and a separate seeded `fixtures/sample-status` commit status.

The README links each case, explains the synthetic author review and commit status, and points to the 16 downloaded responses and refresh commands in `workspace-prototype`. Seeding was completed through #3; this PR leaves the preservation instructions open for review.

Validation: sample JSON parses; GitHub confirms all seeded states, comments, review and CI data; the prototype’s capture commands were replayed and all 16 JSON files validated. The prototype passes lint, typecheck and all 348 tests with the local stack.

Related: https://github.com/laserjm/workspace-prototype/issues/55.
